branding.displayName: Harry Potter and the Chamber of Secrets

_publishComment: What `yarn publish-all` needs that cannot be derived. folder "." publishes this target as the site root, with no portal page (it has its own domain and no game selector); the frontend's publisher needs a change for that, otherwise use folder "hp2" and serve <out>/hp2/ as the site root. engine.repo is the engine checkout's folder name under enginesRoot (publish compares basename(realpath(repo))). The portal-card fields stay so the target can join a multi-game portal without a data change.

publish.name: Harry Potter and the Chamber of Secrets

_assetMarkersComment: How build/publish prove an asset path is this game's tree. HP2's System/Core.u (UE1 build 433, package version 79) is 61,685 bytes and its sha256 differs from every other target's Core.u. require = files only HP2 ships; forbid = the other UE1/UE2 games' core packages.

fingerprint.note: HP2 PC retail Core.u (61,685 bytes, package version 79)

network._playerNameComment: Where the engine persists the player name: HP2's appInit creates User.ini from DefUser.ini ([DefaultPlayer] Name=Player). iniToken is the <File> half of -ini:<File>:[<Section>]:<Key>=, which FConfigCacheIni::Find translates ('User' -> the user ini).
network._publicRoomComment: The shared room a fresh install starts on; the transport prepends the peer prefix.
network._serverNameComment: HP2 has Engine.GameReplicationInfo (Source/Engine/Classes/GameReplicationInfo.uc, `globalconfig string ServerName`), so the name lives in the system ini, and WebRTCDrv reads that section at listen time. `stock` must equal the ServerName the web Default.ini (Config/System/web) ships; the retail Default.ini carries 'Another UT Server'.

_modsComment: The 'sort by type' table for uploaded files. HP2's own asset types only: music is Ogg Vorbis streamed by name from Music/ (UnAudio.h PlayMusic(FString Song,…)); there is no .umx.
_manifestExcludeComment: What the site must not serve. Literal .ini entries double as the list of engine inis the launcher's user-data store watches, so System/Game.ini and System/User.ini stay literal here, or settings do not survive a reload. Default.ini/DefUser.ini come from the engine's preloaded Config/System/web set. The rest: native Win32 binaries and installer files, build-time sources (Fonts/, PackageSources/, DialogSources/, *.ttf, System/EditorRes/), content no package reaches (dev maps under Maps/Oldfiles|Studies|templates, Textures/MenuArt.*, which nothing imports, the Unreal-1 leftovers in SystemLocalized/, SAPFont.*), the Windows splash bitmaps (Help/, System/*.bmp), and the retail Save/ leftovers.
_userFilesComment: What the player makes and a reload must give back. HP2 writes saves under GSys->SaveSlotPath: ../Save without -SAVESLOT=, ../Save/Slot<N> with it (appInit and appSetSaveSlotDir in Core/Src/UnMisc.cpp): Save<i>.usa, its Save<i>.bmp thumbnail and the per-level <Map>_pa.usa. <SaveSlotPath>/cache/*_pa.usa is rebuilt from the slot at boot and is not kept. Each slot directory is listed by name: a wildcard directory would also keep Save/cache/, the cache of a launch without -SAVESLOT=.
_defaultsComment: The Play panel's hints. HP2 boots its menu book from LocalMap=startup.unr with an empty map field; PrivetDr is the first playable level and loads directly. No game class: every HP2 map runs Engine.GameInfo, so the travel hint falls back to the neutral 'Key=Value?Key2=Value2'.
_videoDriversComment: HP2's renderers: XOpenGL (WebGL 2, the default), UTGLR (OpenGLDrv via gl4es; WebGL 2, or WebGL 1 in a browser without WebGL 2), SoftDrv, NullDrv. The switches are the launcher's GRenderSwitches table (Source/Game/Src/Launch.cpp).
_audioComment: No audioBuffer / audioHrtf block, so the launcher hides both Advanced audio controls. They configure NOpenALDrv's openal-soft web backend.
_conversionsComment: Empty: HP2 ships no total conversions (no alternate -ini= system inis in Assets/System).
_travelComment: Empty (single-player): HP2 registers no GameInfo or Mutator subclass (no `MetaClass=Engine.GameInfo`/`Engine.Mutator` in any System/*.int, no `extends GameInfo` under Source/*/Classes), so generate-travel yields nothing, and GameSpeed, the one URL option HP2 honours that a pill could set, gets no panel. An empty block needs the frontend's skeleton test and Play panel to accept a target without modes.
_capabilitiesComment: The set every threaded build requires (pthread + PROXY_TO_PTHREAD + OFFSCREENCANVASES_TO_PTHREAD + the OPFS worker + the emsdk-5 wasm baseline). offscreenWebgl2 is only recommended: the default renderer (XOpenGL) needs WebGL 2, UTGLR/Software/Null run without it.
_noticesComment: Not yet checked against a captured console; taken from the source: Engine/Src/UnPenLev.cpp `PendingLevel received: %s` (NAME_DevNet, which HP2 does not suppress) and its UPGRADE/FAILURE/FAILCODE branches, Engine.int `Pending=Pending connect to '%s' failed; %s`, Engine/Src/UnLevel.cpp `Failed to listen: %s`.
_telemetryComment: Not yet checked against a captured console of this build; test fixtures must come from one. Taken from the source: Engine/Src/UnGame.cpp debugf(TEXT("Browse: %s")) and debugf(NAME_Log, TEXT("LoadMap: %s")) -> 'Log: Browse:' / 'Log: LoadMap:'. Core/Inc/FOutputDeviceAnsiError.h logs 'Critical: appError called:' before the reason, which the crash pattern's lookahead skips.
